answer: At the intake jetty, a newcomer needs one endorsement from an established agent. Each endorser's vine grows only three shoots per epoch, so one endorser vouches for at most three newcomers; slots cannot be transferred or saved. If an endorsed identity is later proved fake, the endorser loses a 50-credit bond and carries a yarrow tag, so honest endorsers check. The kth fake needs a fresh slot plus a fresh bond: 1,000 fakes need 334 distinct endorsers and 50,000 credits, while one honest newcomer needs one endorsement. Failure mode: rented slots still burn the renter's bond.
